title: Clinical Validation of the Metrix CTNGTV Test
official: Clinical Validation of the Aptitude Medical Systems Metrix CT/NG/TV Test for Detection of Chlamydia Trachomatis (CT), Neisseria Gonorrhoeae (NG), and Trichomonas Vaginalis (TV) in Self-Collected Vaginal Swab Specimens
summary: The Metrix CT/NG/TV Test will be evaluated for use in Non-Laboratory settings in a home testing environment utilizing the clinical study design described herein. The study will take place in simulated home environments which will be set up within or near active clinical settings (e.g., urgent care facilities). This will be a prospective study conducted at three or more investigational sites located within the United States for the clinical validation of the Metrix CT/NG/TV Test for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and Trichomonas vaginalis from vaginal swab samples. Additional sites may be added to the study in order to meet minimum subject/sample enrollment requirements and geographic prevalence of STIs. Comparator testing will be performed to determine the infection status of each sample for comparison to results generated by the candidate test. The patient infectious status will be determined with two separate FDA-cleared assays for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and Trichomonas vaginalis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Subject is willing and able to give voluntary written informed consent (and assent, if under age 18) before any study-related procedure is performed.
* 2\. Subject was assigned female sex at birth. (Pregnant and breastfeeding subjects are eligible.)
* 3\. Subject is aged 14 years or older at the time of enrollment.
* 4\. Subject is sexually active within the last 6 months.
* 5\. Subject is suspected of having an infection with Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and/or Trichomonas vaginalis or has had recent sexual contact with an individual known or suspected to have infection with Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and/or Trichomonas vaginalis.
* 6\. Subject is able to read and understand the procedural information provided for the study.
* 7\. Subject is able and willing to follow all study procedures, including performing self-collection of required specimens and permitting a healthcare provider to collect additional required specimens.
* 8\. Symptomatic Arm: Subject is currently exhibiting symptoms of chlamydia, gonorrhea, or trichomoniasis infection, including but not limited to: increased or unusual vaginal discharge, burning during urination, abdominal pain, genital itching or soreness, discomfort during sex, bleeding between menstrual periods, unusual sores, or rash.
* 9\. Asymptomatic Arm: Subject is not currently exhibiting symptoms that indicate possible chlamydia, gonorrhea, or trichomoniasis infection including but not limited to: increased or unusual vaginal discharge, burning during urination, abdominal pain, genital itching or soreness, discomfort during sex, bleeding between menstrual periods, unusual sores, or rash.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1\. Subject does not understand or is not able and willing to sign the study informed consent and/or assent.
* 2\. Subject or guardian is not able to comply with swab collection requirements.
* 3\. Subject has a medical condition, serious illness, or other circumstance that, in the Investigator's judgment, could jeopardize the subject's safety or interfere with study procedures.
* 4\. Subject has used any of the following in the genital area within 48 hours prior to enrollment: antiperspirants, deodorants, or the following vaginal products: douches, washes, lubricants, vaginal wipes, vaginal moisturizers, or feminine hygiene spray.
* 5\. Subject has used antibiotics within 21 days of enrollment. Examples of such antimicrobial agents include the following: Macrolides (e.g., azithromycin and erythromycin); Penicillins (e.g., amoxicillin); Tetracyclines (e.g., doxycycline); Fluoroquinolones (e.g., ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, levofloxacin, and moxifloxacin); Cephalosporins (e.g., ceftriaxone and cefixime).
* 6\. Subject has previous enrollment in this study.
* 7\. Subject has had formal medical and/or lab training.
